Minecraft servers.

Your personal Minecraft server

We give you your very own personal Minecraft server, where you can play on with your friends all day and all night.

Get yours now
For Free

We are free, and we will always be free for everyone at any time. There is no possibility to pay for anything.

Pay nothing now
Easy to use

We don't know, why it could be complicated to own a Minecraft server. At Aternos it is just as easy as pressing a button.

Press a button now
Built to be played

We offer you servers that you can actually play and have fun on. Lots of fun. No unnecessary restrictions to steal your time and money.

Play now
The best Minecraft server hosting, completely for free.

Free doesn't mean less. We've been hosting Minecraft servers since 2013 and have built countless features to make your server as good as it can be, some of which you won't even find at many paid hosts.

Because we believe the best Minecraft hosting should be available to everyone, every single one of them is included for every player, completely for free.

Create your free Minecraft server

Features
Fully Customizable
Adjust everything on your server the way you like it and make it your game.
Mods & Plugins
Vanilla is too boring for you? Add plugins, play with your favourite mods or use one of many preconfigured modpacks for your very own experience.
DDOS Protected
Your Minecraft server is fully DDOS protected for free to keep you safe from attacks.
Automatic Backups
We can keep a backup of your server in your Google Drive, just in case you need it.
Custom Worlds
Adventure maps, parkour or the latest minigame. You can upload any world you want to play.
Excellent Support
If you need help, we are here to help.
Get Help

Features

Your own survival multiplayer experience, free forever.
Custom domains
Use your own domain to connect to your server.
Share access
Don't run your server alone. Share access with your friends and manage your server together.
Unlimited slots
Play with as many friends as you want without unnecessary slot limitations.
Add-Ons & Datapacks
Expand your vanilla experience with our easy drag and drop upload for Bedrock add-ons and datapacks.
Real-time console
Managing your server couldn't be easier with our real-time live console.
